description: Source code for WiFi harvester module handling instant measurements, device association, and telemetry data reporting, including webconfig and event handling.

methods.name: process_instant_msmt_stop
methods.description: Stops the instant measurement process, frees resources, and signals termination.

methods.name: process_instant_msmt_monitor
methods.description: Handles provider response to trigger instant measurement monitoring or stop if threshold reached.

methods.name: upload_single_client_msmt_data
methods.description: Prepares and sends telemetry data for a single WiFi client using Avro serialization.

methods.name: process_instant_msmt_start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the instant measurement process, allocating resources and signaling start.

methods.name: monitor_enable_instant_msmt
methods.description: Enables or disables instant measurements for a specific client MAC address.

methods.name: harvester_str_to_mac_bytes
methods.description: Converts MAC address string to byte array.

methods.name: instant_msmt_macAddr
methods.description: Sets the MAC address for instant measurement and associates it with an access point.

methods.name: instant_msmt_ttl
methods.description: Sets the time-to-live for instant measurement reporting.

methods.name: instant_msmt_reporting_period
methods.description: Adjusts the reporting period for instant measurements.

methods.name: instant_msmt_def_period
methods.description: Sets the default period for instant measurements.

methods.name: webconfig_harvester_apply
methods.description: Applies webconfig settings to configure harvester parameters.

methods.name: handle_harvester_webconfig_event
methods.description: Handles webconfig events related to harvester configuration.

methods.name: handle_harvester_provider_response
methods.description: Processes provider responses for instant measurement monitoring.

methods.name: handle_harvester_monitor_event
methods.description: Handles monitor events and dispatches provider responses.

methods.name: handle_harvester_hal_event
methods.description: Handles HAL events such as device disassociation.

methods.name: harvester_event
methods.description: Main event handler dispatching based on event type.
